fee_notes: Royalty is 16% of monthly gross revenues under the License Agreement, with a Minimum Annual Royalty of not less than $32,000 (approx. $2,667/month implied floor). Optional Sylvan Edge Program amendment carries 12% royalty with minimum annual royalty of $2,100 in year 1 and $4,200 in remaining years. Optional Ace It! Program amendment carries 12% royalty with $1,200 minimum annual royalty. Territory Advertising Minimum is 8% of monthly gross revenues, capped at $40,000 per territory per calendar year; optional Sylvan Edge Program adds 3% of monthly gross revenues. A portion of the 16% royalty may be directed toward Sylvan Advertising. Starting in year 6, Minimum Annual Royalty and advertising cap may be adjusted for CPI; the 16% royalty rate and 8% advertising percentage are not subject to CPI adjustment. Hub Technology Platform fee is $114/Center/month. Contact Center Program fee is $700 flat/month plus $10/inquiry (Model A) or $350 flat/month plus $30/inquiry (Model B), required for first 12 months of operation. Dashboard Access License Fee is $10/month per license. Late payments incur a 10% late charge plus 1.5%/month interest.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty | 16% of monthly gross revenues, with a total Minimum Annual Royalty of not less than $32,000, derived from the License Agreement. Optional programs to License Agreement: 12% of monthly gross revenues derived from the Sylvan Edge Program amendment, subject to a minimum annual royalty of $2,100 assessed in the first calendar year and $4,200 assessed in the remaining calendar years; 12% of monthly gross revenues derived from the Ace It! Program amendment, subject to $1,200 minimum annual royalty | Payable by the 15th day of each month. | A portion of the royalty may be directed by Sylvan toward Sylvan Advertising under the License Agreement. For each calendar year, your monthly royalties paid to us must total at least the Minimum Annual Royalty. Non-refundable.
Territory Advertising Minimum for Local Advertising and Co-op Expenditures | 8% of monthly gross revenues, capped at a maximum of $40,000 per territory per calendar year. Optional programs: 3% of monthly gross revenues derived from the Sylvan Edge Program | Payment liability accrues monthly, up to the cap. | Paid to third-party vendors you select and/or your co-op. Non-refundable.
Hub Technology Platform | Currently $114/Center per month | Payable by the 25th day of each month. | Sylvan requires full utilization of the Hub Technology Platform in all Centers. Non-refundable.
1-800-Educate or Other Toll-Free Number | Currently $0.20/minute | Payable by the 25th day of each month.
Contact Center Program Fee | $700 flat fee per month plus $10/inquiry (Model A) or $350 flat fee per month plus $30/inquiry (Model B). | Payable by the 25th day of each month.
Dashboard Access License Fee | $10 per month per license | Monthly upon invoice.
